solution_summary: As a UK local government unitary authority, Somerset Council works to fulfill its mission of offering services in health, education, housing, economy, and environment to its community. Once operating as five distinct councils, each with its own financial management systems, the amalgamation of the groups into one council required building a centralized financial system to enhance data insights, automate manual processes, and optimize efficiencies and transparency. Dynamics 365 was the right solution to keep Somerset Council efficiently delivering the public services so many in its region rely on. Historically, the area had five separate councils, each with its own governance and financial management systems. Some of the business and financial managers relied on old accounting systems and had to fill in the duplications, gaps, and inefficiencies with manual processes.
